Hi Susan — thanks for reporting and for the screenshot. A few things we'll check on our side; possible causes in similar incidents:

- RelayState mismatch or invalid audience in the SAML assertion (SP rejects the assertion and ends the session)
- Very short session TTL set at the IdP or a cookie domain mismatch causing immediate logout
- Clock skew (SAML time validation failing when IdP and SP timestamps differ)

Can you try these two quick troubleshooting steps so we can narrow it down?

1) Try an incognito/private browsing window and follow the invite link again (clears cookies and local state).
2) If that reproduces the issue, please capture a SAML trace (we've included a short how-to on capturing SAML in Chrome: open devtools > Network > filter for SAMLRequest/SAMLResponse, or use SAML-tracer extension). Attach the trace file if possible.

If you prefer, Karthik can provide a temporary re-issued invite token and we can extend the SP assertion accept window while we diagnose.

I'll keep this ticket in procurement triage until confirmed resolved.

Thanks,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-05T07:58:00Z
Subject: Re: Problem accessing supplier portal after invite

Thanks for the trace, Susan — that was helpful. Root cause: our SP metadata still listed the old entityID (legacy-veridian-entity) in the accepted audience list; when your IdP rotated certs it also updated the entityID used in the assertion. The result was an "InvalidAudience" assertion rejection and an immediate session end.

What we changed:
- Added the new Veridian entityID to the SP accepted audiences.
- Reissued a fresh invite token and extended the accepted SAML conditions window by +60s to tolerate minor clock skew while you roll out the cert.
- Uploaded an updated SP metadata file (updated-sp-metadata.xml) to our portal.

Next steps for you (quick):
1) Clear cookies or open an incognito window.
2) Use the new invite link I've just emailed (valid for 48 hours).
3) If you still hit the loop, paste the exact error message or forward the SAMLResponse and we'll take another look.

Ticket: PROC-VER-1254 (internal) — I've set this to high priority until we get confirmation.

-Karthik
